description: This is a shell script responsible for scheduled log upload, telemetry data handling, and maintenance window management in an embedded system environment. It includes functions for generating random wait times, initiating log uploads, running background services, and performing device checks.

methods.name: calcRandTimeandUpload
methods.description: Calculates a random delay for log upload, waits accordingly, and initiates a series of maintenance and upload procedures, including running background services and performing device health checks.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines the build type of the device (DEV, VBN, PROD, CQA) based on the /version.txt file.

methods.name: getTFTPServer
methods.description: Retrieves the TFTP server address based on the build type.
